title: alsinastrum brachyspermum
intro: Alsinastrum brachyspermum, commonly known as "Piquia", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Alsinastrum brachyspermum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic properties, making it a potential remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as piquialine, piquianone, and piquianol.
